title: Interface lemma lifts per-expression refinement to the CFG level (I2F_denote_exp')
intent: Lift the per-expression refinement `I2F_denote_exp` (an `I2F_refine` statement over the MCFG-level `denote_exp`) to the CFG-level interface `I2F_refine_CFG` over `denote_exp'`, so that later obligation files apply `I2F_denote_exp'` instead of unfolding `denote_exp`/`withCall` and re-assembling the UB/OOM cut lemmas by hand.

parent.name: I2F_denote_exp'
parent.statement:
Lemma I2F_denote_exp' :
  forall e τ,
    I2F_refine_CFG I2F_dvalue (@denote_exp' PInf τ e) (@denote_exp' PFin τ e).

children.name: I2F_denote_exp
children.statement:
Lemma I2F_denote_exp :
  forall (e : exp dtyp) τ, I2F_refine (@denote_exp PInf τ e) (@denote_exp PFin τ e).
children.closed_by: induction e; each constructor case closed by erbind plus I2F_refine_lift and the per-constructor I2F_eval_* / I2F_denote_* / I2F_canonicalize_agg lemmas
children.note: Per-expression refinement at the MCFG level (I2F_refine over denote_exp).

children.name: I2F_cutUB_CFG
children.statement:
Lemma I2F_cutUB_CFG :
  eqp1 (@cutUB (@CFGEtop PInf) _) (sum_pred1 FF1 (@cutUB (@MCFGEtop PInf) _)).
children.closed_by: intros A e; split; intros CUT; depelim CUT / destruct CUT; depelim HC; exact (CutUB v)
children.note: The CFG-level UB cut predicate equals its structural decomposition.

children.name: I2F_cutOOM_CFG
children.statement:
Lemma I2F_cutOOM_CFG :
  eqp1 (@cutOOM (@CFGEtop PFin) _) (sum_pred1 FF1 (@cutOOM (@MCFGEtop PFin) _)).
children.closed_by: intros A e; split; intros CUT; depelim CUT / destruct CUT; depelim HC; exact (CutOOM v)
children.note: The CFG-level OOM cut predicate equals its structural decomposition.

applicability.goal_shape: A refinement statement `I2F_refine_CFG RR (@denote_exp' P τ e) (@denote_exp' P' τ e)` whose head symbol `I2F_refine_CFG` is `ruttc cutUB cutOOM I2FE_CFG I2FA_CFG`, and whose operand `denote_exp' := withCall (denote_exp ...)` injects a lower-signature (MCFG) tree into a higher-signature (CFG) tree that adds the Call event and the UB/OOM cuts.
applicability.use_when: a per-component refinement is already proved at one signature level (here MCFG) and the client-facing statements live at another (CFG); state the boundary lemma once so downstream files apply it instead of unfolding the definition and re-attaching the cut predicates.
applicability.avoid_when: the two signature levels are not definitionally related (the lower tree is not injected into the higher one by a `withCall`-style constructor), or the cut predicates at the higher level are not the structural decomposition of the lower ones (then the boundary lemma would need a substantive proof rather than `exact`); also avoid when no downstream client reuses the lemma.

consequences: Creates the obligation that the higher-signature refinement is exactly the lower refinement composed with the cut predicates; here it is discharged by `ruttc_translate_inr'` plus the two `I2F_cut*_CFG` structural lemmas and two inline sum-rel side conditions. The boundary lemma becomes the single point clients cite, so a change to the higher signature (a new event) breaks only this lemma and its cut side conditions, not the client files that cite it.
